key_idea: Killing the higher self-extensions of a module over a symmetric algebra by embedding it into a triangular matrix algebra along a specially constructed stable map (the triangular conversion principle).
reason: The proof features a highly inventive conceptual core that brilliantly reduces the conjecture to finding a base algebra with specific Ext properties. However, carrying out this elegant high-level strategy inevitably requires a heavy amount of technical bookkeeping, explicit basis computations, and a long chain of specialized lemmas.
